_about: Golden regression set, tier 2: QUESTION -> ANSWER, through the language model.
and the local DuckDB; ~10-60 s per question). Each case states the route and
template the app must choose, variables the plan must use, numbers the answer
must contain (matched at the precision written), and phrases it must never
contain. Because the model is nondeterministic the script reports a pass rate
per case; a case that fails once is worth reading, one that fails twice is a bug.
